crossRefs.note: Therefore though I have all boldness in Christ to command you that which is appropriate,
yet for love’s sake I rather beg, being such a one as Paul, the aged, but also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.
We don’t control your faith, but are fellow workers with you for your joy. For you stand firm in faith.
not as lording it over those entrusted to you, but making yourselves examples to the flock.

For if I do this of my own will, I have a reward. But if not of my own will, I have a stewardship entrusted to me.
For if the readiness is there, it is acceptable according to what you have, not according to what you don’t have.

translations.web: But I was willing to do nothing without your consent, that your goodness would not be as of necessity, but of free will.
translations.bsb: But I did not want to do anything without your consent, so that your goodness will not be out of compulsion, but by your own free will.
translations.kjv: But without thy mind would I do nothing; that thy benefit should not be as it were of necessity, but willingly.
translations.asv: but without thy mind I would do nothing; that thy goodness should not be as of necessity, but of free will.
